title: 你掉的是這一把嗎
subject: a clerk at a metro station lost-and-found who logs four hundred umbrellas a week beside false teeth, a guitar and a bag of live crabs, and a retired man who asks every Tuesday after the same old watch
caption: Mandarin piano rock in the guitarless Taiwanese piano-trio style. A hard-hit acoustic grand piano pounding chords in the left hand with fast right-hand runs; a fuzzy overdriven electric bass playing the riffs a guitar would; loud open live drums with crash cymbals and tom fills; a toy glockenspiel doubling the chorus melody. Raw live-room recording, piano bright and up front, gritty bass, roomy drums. Female mezzo-alto, clear and wry, talking through the verses and belting the chorus with a slight rasp. 138 BPM, B-flat major. Wry, brisk and warm-hearted. No electric guitar, no ballad slowdown, no autotune, no EDM synths, no trap drums.
lyrics:
[Intro - pounding piano chords and drum fill]

[Verse 1]
捷運站 地下二樓 失物招領
一張桌子 一台電腦 一本登記簿
這禮拜 收了四百一十二把傘
一副假牙 一把吉他 一袋還在動的螃蟹

[Pre-Chorus]
有人衝進來 喘著氣 說他掉了東西
我把手 放在那一排傘上面

[Chorus]
你掉的是金的 還是銀的
還是這一把 透明的塑膠傘
不要急 慢慢說 它長什麼樣子
你掉的 是這一把嗎

[Verse 2]
有個阿伯 每個禮拜二都來
問一支黑色的舊錶 有沒有人撿到
我每次都說 再等等看
他每次都說 好 那我下禮拜再來

[Pre-Chorus]
今天下午 它躺在雜物箱的最底下
指針還在走 比我上班還準時

[Chorus]
你掉的是金的 還是銀的
還是這一支 等了三個月的錶
阿伯笑著說 金的銀的都不要
你掉的 就是這一支吧

[Outro - piano runs and crashing cymbals]
四百一十二把傘
還在等 下一場雨
